# New Zealand

> [!summary] Data available
> Moderate: recipes from [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] (645) and [[RecipeDB2]] (≈1,120, samples only), dish lists in [[WorldCuisines]] (20) and [[FmLAMA]] (9), and some Māori plant medicine (rongoā) in [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]. No BLEnD file, no FCT in the vault; compounds via [[Global]].

## Foods & dishes
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 645 recipes tagged `new-zealand` (ingredients without amounts, steps, nutrition).
- [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈1,120 recipes (v1 region "Australian"); amounts, steps, nutrition; samples only held.
- [[CulinaryDB]]: shares the "Australia & NZ" label (494 recipes) with Australia.
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 20 dishes, 3 NZ-only (Afghan biscuit, cheese roll, *rēwena* bread); others shared with Australia/UK (Anzac biscuit, damper, crumpet).
- [[FmLAMA]]: 9 dishes (77 rows), e.g. pavlova, hokey pokey, *rewena* bread, colonial goose, pineapple lumps.
- No BLEnD or World Wide Dishes entries; rēwena bread is the only Māori dish found in these lists.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No NZ FCT (the New Zealand Food Composition Database / FOODfiles) in the vault or `Backlog/`; use [[USDA FoodData Central]]. [[FooDB]] has kiwi and sweet potato (for *kūmara*).
- [[CMAUP]]: 112 plants. [[KNApSAcK Family]]: flag page, counts not scraped.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 150 records (61 taxa), of which 19 are labelled Niue; Māori medicinal plants such as kawakawa (*Piper excelsum*, 14), *Coprosma*, *Pomaderris* and kānuka (*Leptospermum ericoides*).
- [[NPASS]]: 160 species–compound pairs. [[Exposome-Explorer]]: 71 rows (62 concentrations, 9 correlations).
- Global backbone via [[Global]].

## Gaps
- No NZ FCT and no BLEnD-style everyday-food QA.
- Māori and Pasifika food culture is barely represented; rongoā is limited to Duke's old records.
